data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts the joint requirement is 'logically impossible' and that 'no single candidate can satisfy' it, but this is false: a candidate whose verdict is both internally coherent (sound) and pertinent to the dispute (relevant) at the meta-level, and whose verdict also substantively progresses the object-level frontier claim, satisfies both constraints simultaneously. The two demands operate at different levels but are not mutually exclusive, so the impossibility claim is unsupported.
